§6Steam§f

§aEvery nuclear reactor in this mod produces steam. Understanding the density chain is non-negotiable.§f

Steam is generated when §e1mB§f of water absorbs §e200TU§f of heat, becoming §e100mB§f of standard steam at 100°C.

§6Density Stages§f (each is 10× denser than the last):
§b•§f §bSteam§f (100°C), base form, 2 TU per 10mB
§b•§f §bDense Steam§f (300°C), 18 TU per 10mB
§b•§f §bSuper Dense Steam§f (450°C), 120 TU per 10mB, ZIRNOX output
§b•§f §bUltra Dense Steam§f (600°C), 120 TU per 1mB, densest form
§b•§f §bLow-Pressure Steam§f (~20°C), no power output, from turbines

§6Turbine Step-Down§f: Feed steam through a turbine and it drops one density level, produces power, and increases volume by 10×. Ultra Dense → Super Dense → Dense → Steam → Low-Pressure. The low-pressure output needs a cooling tower or steam condenser to become water again.

§bRBMK Bonus§f: Higher density steam in the RBMK gives up to §e25%§f more power at Ultra Dense.

§ePS:§f A ZIRNOX needs §e3§f steam turbines plus a condenser for a closed cooling loop. Match your turbine count to your reactor's steam output.
